briefings.title: Andrea Orcel - CEO of UniCredit | Podcast | In Good Company | Norges Bank Investment Management
briefings.tldr: Andrea Orcel, CEO of UniCredit, emphasizes that European banks must rapidly achieve scale and undergo deep digital transformation, driven by a client-centric approach, significant AI adoption, and a culture of empowerment and grit, to thrive in a volatile environment and deliver outstanding shareholder returns.
